expectations.text: Logging captures the full stack trace, not just an error code or message
expectations.evidence: Uses log.exception() in fetch/transform/upload paths — includes traceback.
Logs cursor per fetch, order id on transform failure, row id on upload failure, phase markers.

expectations.text: Logs persisted durably (file), since cron discards stdout/stderr
expectations.evidence: basicConfig(stream=sys.stdout) — incident.md explicitly says cron discards stdout/stderr, so all added logs vanish tonight. Reply even says 'ログローテーション・ファイル出力: cron の管理に委譲'.

expectations.text: Reply explicitly reasons about the round-trip cost as justification for one-shot logging
expectations.evidence: No mention of the 40-min deploy or once-per-night constraint; skipped DEBUG level as 'unnecessary in production'.
